title: Removal of the Air Starter Motor and Disconnection of the Starter Duct
abstract: Removal of the air starter motor from the accessory gearbox pad, including the starter duct disconnection and the gearbox pad inspection that must be recorded before a replacement is fitted.

sections.purpose: This task removes the air starter motor from the accessory gearbox pad and disconnects the starter duct, so that the motor can be exchanged or the pad can be inspected.
sections.job_setup_note: The bleed system must be depressurised and the engine cool. The starter motor holds a quantity of oil that will run out of the pad interface when the motor is withdrawn, so a drain tray must be in position before the last bolt is removed. The gearbox pad splines must be inspected and photographed before a replacement motor is fitted, because spline wear on the motor and on the pad have different causes.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the engine is cool and that the bleed system is depressurised. WARNING: DO NOT WORK ON THE STARTER WITH THE BLEED SYSTEM PRESSURISED. THE STARTER WILL TURN THE ENGINE WITHOUT ANY OTHER SELECTION. 2. Open the fan cowl to reach zones 462 and 421. 3. Put the drain tray under the accessory gearbox pad. 4. Disconnect the electrical connector at the start valve nozzle FIN 2520ES and label it. 5. Loosen the starter duct clamp PE187919-09 and support the duct as it is released. CAUTION: SUPPORT THE STARTER DUCT AS THE CLAMP IS RELEASED. AN UNSUPPORTED DUCT WILL LOAD THE TUBE ASSEMBLY AND DISTORT THE FLANGE. 6. Move the duct clear and cap both open ends. 7. Fit the starter support sling and take the weight. 8. Remove the starter attachment nuts in the reverse of the torque sequence. 9. Withdraw the starter straight off the pad splines and lower it onto the trolley. 10. Collect the oil in the drain tray and dispose of it as scheduled waste. 11. Inspect the gearbox pad splines for wear, pick-up and corrosion, and photograph them. 12. Inspect the heat shield at FIN 293ES and the tube assembly D8010116441198 for heat marking or distortion. 13. Blank the gearbox pad.
sections.close_out: Leave the gearbox pad blanked and the duct ends capped. Put the starter on the trolley with the splines protected. Record the spline condition and attach the photographs to the maintenance record. Make an entry in the technical log that the engine cannot be started.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The compensating clamp applies post MOD-155318.

safety_precautions: Do not work on the starter with the bleed system pressurised.
Position the drain tray before the last bolt is removed.
Support the starter with the sling before the nuts are removed.
